# Product Strategist

Create product strategy artefacts such as OKRs, roadmaps and competitive reviews.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Strategic product leadership toolkit for Head of Product covering OKR cascade generation, quarterly planning, competitive landscape analysis, product vision documents, and team scaling proposals. Use when creating quarterly OKR documents, defining product goals or KPIs, building product roadmaps, running competitive analysis, drafting team structure or hiring plans, aligning product strategy across engineering and design, or generating cascaded goal hierarchies from company to team level.

Example request:

> Use product-strategist to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill product-strategist
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/product-strategist/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/product-strategist/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
